questions: Which form of energy is spreading out in straight lines?
Where is the stored energy waiting, and what wakes it up?
segments.say: Energy comes in many forms. Watch the light rays lengthen and spread from the lamp, the heat circle drift upwards, the sound lines spread outward, the movement circle slide along, and the stored dot drop into its box and wait. Keep your student notes open at the light, heat and sound definitions for this scene.

questions: Which everyday object gives out each form of energy?
What energy change makes the car move?
segments.say: We use energy every day. Watch the lamp rays reach up, the steam puffs rise as cooking heat escapes from the pot, the radio sound lines spread out, and the car roll as stored energy becomes movement. Now try the radio and car questions on the worksheet in pairs.

questions: Where does the energy wait before it travels?
Into which two forms does the electrical energy change at the bulb?
segments.say: Energy changes form. Watch the energy wait stored in the battery, then follow the yellow dot as it travels along the wire to the bulb - and watch the bulb light up as electrical energy becomes light, with a wisp of heat rising away. Check this against the electrical energy definition in your student notes.

questions: Where does the energy dot start, and where does it end up?
Why is it wrong to say the energy has been used up?
segments.say: A common mistake: is energy used up? Watch the wrong line being crossed out, then follow the energy dot along the chain from the stored circle to the heat circle: the same energy, changed in form and moved somewhere else. Finish by taking the exit ticket on your own - its first question revisits exactly the used-up trap.
segments.watchFor: Energy is used up, like fuel disappearing from a tank. Listen and look for it in pair talk and on the exit ticket: A lamp or a toy runs out, so the energy feels consumed. Send them back to scene s4 and to the correct turn: Energy is never used up: it changes form and moves somewhere else.
